versions.changelog:
0.2.0.0 - Kinopoisk metadata source: movies, series and episodes (titles, overview,
tagline, year, premiere, age rating, rating, genres, countries, status, people),
poster/cover/logo images, "Identify" search by title or Kinopoisk id, Kinopoisk id
field and link. Episodes are matched by season and episode number within the series.
0.1.0.0 - Plugin skeleton: configuration page (Kinopoisk API key, actor limit),
CI build and plugin repository manifest.

name: Kinopoisk Updater
description: Adds Kinopoisk as a metadata and image source. Use the standard "Refresh metadata" (replace all) on a movie, series, season or episode to update titles, overview, taglines, dates, ratings, genres, countries, people and poster from Kinopoisk; "Identify" searches Kinopoisk by title or id.
overview: Kinopoisk metadata source for movies, series, seasons and episodes
